_note: SCHEMATIC EXAMPLE. The NZBN API is key-gated (HTTP 401 without a free subscription key), so identity values here are PLACEHOLDERS, not copied from any record. NZBN is the 13-digit join key; company_number is the Companies Register id. NZ has GST not VAT; IRD/GST numbers are not public. financial_statements are FMC-reporting-only (Disclose/Companies registers) — empty here. officers (directors) are personal data (Privacy Act 2020) and are not in the public NZBN tier.
